id, dataset_id, case_key, input_json, expected_output_json, assertions_json, tags_json, weight, enabled, revision, created_at, updated_at

id, mode, dataset_id, dataset_revision, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, evaluator_snapshot, status, requested_by, requested_roles, requested_permissions, requested_auth_version, total_items, completed_items, failed_items, config_json, summary_json, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at

id, eval_run_id, case_id, case_revision, conversation_id, run_id, trace_id, root_span_id, final_status, input_snapshot, expected_snapshot, output_snapshot, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cost, status, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at

mapper.insert: insert into ai_eval_dataset (id, dataset_key, name, description, owner_id, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{datasetKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select from ai_eval_dataset where owner_id = #{ownerId} order by updated_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.update: update ai_eval_dataset set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and revision = #{expectedRevision} and status != 'ARCHIVED'
update ai_eval_dataset set status = 'ARCHIVED', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and status != 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.insert: insert into ai_eval_case (id, dataset_id, case_key, input_json, expected_output_json, assertions_json, tags_json, weight, enabled, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{datasetId}, #{caseKey}, cast(#{inputJson} as jsonb), cast(#{expectedOutputJson} as jsonb), cast(#{assertionsJson} as jsonb), cast(#{tagsJson} as jsonb), #{weight}, #{enabled}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select from ai_eval_case where dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by case_key limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.update: update ai_eval_case set input_json = cast(#{inputJson} as jsonb), expected_output_json = cast(#{expectedOutputJson} as jsonb), assertions_json = cast(#{assertionsJson} as jsonb), tags_json = cast(#{tagsJson} as jsonb), weight = #{weight}, enabled = #{enabled}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and dataset_id = #{datasetId} and revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_eval_run (id, mode, dataset_id, dataset_revision, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, evaluator_snapshot, requested_by, requested_roles, requested_permissions, requested_auth_version, total_items, config_json, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{mode}, #{datasetId}, #{datasetRevision}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{agentReleaseId}, #{manifestDigest}, cast(#{evaluatorSnapshotJson} as jsonb), #{requestedBy}, cast(#{requestedRolesJson} as jsonb), cast(#{requestedPermissionsJson} as jsonb), #{requestedAuthVersion}, #{totalItems}, cast(#{configJson} as jsonb), #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select from ai_eval_run where requested_by = #{ownerId} order by created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select id from ai_eval_run where mode = 'DATASET' and (status in ('QUEUED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until < now())) order by created_at limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_eval_run set status = case when status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' then status else 'RUNNING' end, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), started_at = coalesce(started_at, now()), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and (status in ('QUEUED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_until < now()))
mapper.select: select id from ai_eval_dataset where id = #{id} for update
select count(*) from ai_eval_run where requested_by = #{owner} and mode = 'DATASET' and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
mapper.update: update ai_eval_run set status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and mode = 'DATASET' and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: select s.metric_key, s.source, count(*) as sample_count, sum((case when s.score_type = 'BOOLEAN' then case when s.score_boolean then 1 else 0 end else s.score_number end) * coalesce((r.input_snapshot ->> '_weight')::numeric, 1)) / nullif(sum(coalesce((r.input_snapshot ->> '_weight')::numeric, 1)), 0) as weighted_mean from ai_eval_score s join ai_eval_result r on r.id = s.result_id where r.eval_run_id = #{id} and s.status = 'ACTIVE' and s.score_type in ('BOOLEAN', 'NUMERIC') group by s.metric_key, s.source order by s.metric_key, s.source
mapper.update: update ai_eval_run set lease_until = now(), lease_owner = null, completed_items = (select count(*) from ai_eval_result where eval_run_id = #{id} and status = 'COMPLETED'), failed_items = (select count(*) from ai_eval_result where eval_run_id = #{id} and status = 'FAILED') where id = #{id} and lease_owner = #{owner}
update ai_eval_run set lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_owner = #{owner}

update ai_eval_run set status = #{status}, completed_items = #{completedItems}, failed_items = #{failedItems}, summary_json = cast(#{summaryJson} as jsonb), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = now(), updated_at = now(), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{id} and lease_owner = #{owner} and status in ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
mapper.insert: insert into ai_eval_result (id, eval_run_id, case_id, case_revision, conversation_id, run_id, input_snapshot, expected_snapshot, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{evalRunId}, #{caseId}, #{caseRevision}, #{conversationId}, #{runId}, cast(#{inputJson} as jsonb), cast(#{expectedJson} as jsonb), #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select from ai_eval_result where eval_run_id = #{evalRunId} order by created_at limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.update: update ai_eval_result set run_id = #{runId}, conversation_id = #{conversationId}, trace_id = #{traceId}, root_span_id = #{rootSpanId}, final_status = #{finalStatus}, output_snapshot = cast(#{outputJson} as jsonb), duration_ms = #{durationMs}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update ai_eval_score set status = 'SUPERSEDED' where result_id = #{resultId} and evaluator_key = 'human_review' and metric_key = #{metricKey} and coalesce(span_id, '') = coalesce(#{spanId}, '') and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select id from ai_eval_result where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into ai_eval_score (id, result_id, evaluator_key, evaluator_version, scope, trace_id, span_id, metric_key, score_type, score_number, score_boolean, score_label, score_text, reason, evidence_json, source, reviewer_id, created_at) values (#{id}, #{resultId}, #{evaluatorKey}, #{evaluatorVersion}, #{scope}, #{traceId}, #{spanId}, #{metricKey}, #{scoreType}, #{scoreNumber}, #{scoreBoolean}, #{scoreLabel}, #{scoreText}, #{reason}, cast(#{evidenceJson} as jsonb), #{source}, #{reviewerId}, #{now}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select from ai_eval_score where result_id = #{resultId} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by scope, metric_key, created_at

select r.id from ai_run r where r.status in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') and not exists (select 1 from ai_eval_result e where e.run_id = r.id) and exists (select 1 from ai_conversation c where c.id = r.conversation_id and c.source = 'USER') order by r.finished_at nulls last, r.created_at limit #{limit}

select r.id as run_id, r.conversation_id, r.question, r.actor, r.agent_key, r.agent_version, r.agent_release_id, r.manifest_digest, r.status, r.trace_context, r.usage_json, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.created_at from ai_run r where r.id = #{runId}
select id, tool_name, status, decision, deny_reason, args_summary, result_summary, duration_ms, trace_id, created_at, finished_at from ai_tool_call where run_id = #{runId} order by created_at
select id, role, content, status, seq, created_at from ai_message where run_id = #{runId} order by seq
